resources.string: Discover and control a webOS TV on your local Wi-Fi

Keep your phone and TV on the same network and enable LG Connect Apps on the TV. On first connection, a permission prompt normally appears on the TV; accept it with the TV remote. A phone PIN is usually not needed. Dioxamine stores the approved client key encrypted on this device.
UPnP media renderer; confirm it is your LG TV
Wake-on-LAN MAC learned. Power-on also requires Wake-on-LAN / Turn on via Wi-Fi to be enabled in TV settings.
This removes the saved encrypted client key and Wake-on-LAN address from this device. You will need to approve pairing on the TV again.

Dioxamine tries secure WSS first and checks the TV certificate against LG webOS certificate pins. Older TVs may require unencrypted WebSocket on the local network; use a trusted Wi-Fi network. Turning the TV on uses Wake-on-LAN and depends on the TV setting.
